answer: The lagoon cap is checked at intake and wander reveals the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a quartz tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 22 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
